items.quote: Two apps built with different store_root values do not see each other's documents on GET /corpus.
full-delete only reports graph/vector/kv store touches for stores it actually changed.
The lightrag full-ingest part declares mutates_store (not writes_artifact with scope quarantined)
Concurrent LightRAG writes to one working dir are serialized
Adapter input and failures are validated, named and readable: CorpusOpSubprocessError keeps the last 2000 characters of v1 stderr
return a named 'v1 not configured' refusal listing the missing key names (never values)
A LightRAG ingest that exceeds its wall-clock ceiling (900 s ingest, 300 s delete, 60 s status) marks its document as stuck/interrupted
An upload of an unsupported type returns a named refusal, not 200.
no corpus-inbox file outlives its job.
IngestJob.job_id is the track_id v1 recorded for the run.
